method: Deduplicate only when report and ledger slices share a tracked product/test path boundary and their stated behavior is the same capability. Broad files such as dispatch.rs, TimelineContainer.tsx or Preview.tsx are not sufficient without semantic agreement. Products/tests are exact-object unions; record IDs retain their source prefix and are never coalesced.

tests.name: does not let a late old snapshot replace a newer project
does not let pending history cross a same-identity compatibility replacement

report: Two documentation headings describe one shared state-boundary slice. Existing store tests do not prove the complete Rust-projection and pure-selector boundary.
ledger: Version/epoch ordering and DTO snapshot races are directly covered.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices own the Rust-projected, version/epoch ordered frontend mirror boundary through web/src/store/sync.ts; keep one capability and union the pure-selector plus race evidence.

tests.name: matches SPEC §5.2: x=frame*ppf, y=trackY+2, width=dur*ppf, height=trackH-4
snaps to the nearest clip edge within threshold

report: TimelineContainer imports and calls the snap and geometry owners, but the full sticky, multi-target, and both 1.5x threshold acceptance matrix is absent.
ledger: Named geometry helpers and boundary tests are tracked.
Sticky/playhead logic exists; the exact held-target test matrix is missing.

duplicateClusters.rationale: The report slice already combines geometry targets, snap helpers and TimelineContainer integration; the two ledger slices partition that same acceptance boundary, so one unified capability prevents duplicate geometry/snap ownership.

tests.name: paints the systemRed wash + border when missing
paints a dashed box on the gap's track

report: Twelve headings and umbrella records converge on one visual surface. Existing canvas tests are partial and do not prove complete visual order, state, and geometry parity.
ledger: Local painter tests do not prove exact toolbar order and every header/clip/overlay state together.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices cover the same toolbar, ruler, track-header, clip and overlay painter surface and share three product paths plus three test paths.

tests.name: wires copy, paste, link, and swap actions
moves a pure video multi-selection as one rigid track delta

report: The shared interaction owners and partial tests exist, but the complete documented selection, drag, trim, scrub, drop, and context-menu matrix is not covered.
A non-passive wheel owner distinguishes pinch, modifier zoom, and pan, but there is no focused automated gesture acceptance.
ledger: Thirteen exhaustive gesture records share one mouse/trackpad/keyboard acceptance matrix.

duplicateClusters.rationale: The ledger interaction matrix is the umbrella owner for the report's mouse/context/trim matrix and its focused trackpad gesture slice; merging keeps one exhaustive interaction gate.

tests.name: maps clip-relative offsets to ABSOLUTE timeline frames via startFrame

report: Nine headings converge on one Inspector UI slice. Pure helper tests do not exercise component states, tabs, fields, scrubbing, and lanes.
ledger: Text/keyframe owners exist, but aiEdit is never added to the Inspector tab list and no full component matrix exists.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices cover the Inspector text/keyframe component surface and share Inspector, KeyframesPanel and their focused component/navigation tests.

report: Tracked dispatch code routes InspectMedia, generation, upscale, and motion-graphic tools to an explicit not-yet-implemented result, directly contradicting production-reachability requirements.
ledger: These umbrella/checklist records span tool domains; the tracked stub test proves the advertised surface is not closed.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices ask whether every advertised MCP tool reaches production behavior, using the same dispatcher and stub evidence boundary.

report: Generation SDK building blocks exist, but Dispatcher does not call them and no complete placeholder, persistence, import, and N-result finalization path exists.
ledger: GenClient exists, but Dispatcher hard-codes canGenerate=false and stubs generate/upscale; durable placeholder/finalize/import wiring is missing.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices cover generation/upscale dispatch, placeholder persistence and exactly-once terminal finalization and share the client, build-params and planned dispatch test paths.

report: The tracked Chromium owner is an unavailable skeleton and the MCP Add/EditMotionGraphic route is an explicit stub, contradicting a production runner requirement.
ledger: The Chromium production renderer reports unavailable and Agent motion tools remain stubs.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices cover the unavailable Chromium production renderer plus stubbed Agent motion tools and share renderer, pipeline and Tauri command evidence.

report: These are umbrella acceptance records for atomic writes, read-only proposals, linked synchronization, and the full agent call chain, not independent document-edit tasks.
ledger: README headings are cross-cutting acceptance records, not distinct implementation features.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices are umbrella acceptance for read-only proposals, atomic shared-command writes, linked synchronization and the complete agent call chain.

report: Dispatcher explicitly returns a needs-vision-backend error; existing autocrop and planning building blocks are not wired to the production dispatch path.
ledger: Analysis/intent helpers exist, but production smart_reframe deterministically reports the missing vision backend.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices describe the same autocrop/intent/dispatcher path and the same deterministic missing-vision-backend contradiction.

report: Normalization and stable accounts are implemented and tested, while the broader negative secret-leakage contract lacks complete acceptance coverage.
ledger: OS keyring storage and masked status exist; one negative project/log/telemetry boundary test remains.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices cover normalized OS-keychain storage plus the negative project/log/telemetry leakage boundary and share the keys implementation and tests.

report: Five heading records duplicate one implemented and tested short-ID contract; they require consolidated evidence closure.
ledger: The exact no-padding sentence and short-id resolver exist with focused tests.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices cover one no-padding/no-guessing short-ID prompt and resolver contract with the same implementation and focused tests.

report: Provider selection, SSE parsing, and tool-loop owners exist, but no explicit orphan tool-use repair owner or test was found.
ledger: Text/tool streaming exists; cache boundaries, usage, mentions/images and durable restart persistence are absent.

duplicateClusters.rationale: The report's provider/SSE/tool-loop gap is the implemented core of the ledger's complete chat contract; both share chat LLM/Tauri owners and SSE tests, so one capability should aggregate remaining cache, usage and persistence gaps.

tests.name: renders 4 corner handles at the OpenTake spacing/opacity tokens matching upstream AppTheme.Spacing.smMd / Opacity.strong

report: Sixteen heading records converge on one shared token capability. Central owners and consumers exist, but there is no complete upstream-table and all-panel-consumption gate.
ledger: Tokens exist; representative cross-panel token usage still needs one acceptance matrix.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices cover the centralized theme/token table and representative cross-panel token consumption through the same theme.ts and tokens.css boundary.

tests.name: handles plain Space in the editor
prevents the native shortcut but ignores repeated KeyS events

report: The hook is mounted by App and covers Space and save, but the complete documented shortcut table is not implemented or tested as a matrix.
ledger: The handler is broad, but current tests cover only part of the exact shortcut table.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices require the complete documented shortcut table, conflict/editable-target rules and platform modifiers through the same hook and test file.

tests.name: renders 4 corner handles at the OpenTake spacing/opacity tokens matching upstream AppTheme.Spacing.smMd / Opacity.strong
does not opt icon buttons out of normal keyboard focus

report: Cursor and hover behavior is scattered across multiple owners; one overlay test does not prove the complete table.
ledger: Distributed hover/focus/cursor behavior needs one cross-component state matrix.

duplicateClusters.rationale: Both slices require one cross-component hover/focus/cursor state matrix and share the same timeline, transform and scrubbable owners plus overlay test boundary.

taxonomyMoves.rationale: These eleven heading-derived records belong to media search, not Inspector/text/keyframes, and duplicate one implemented search capability.
These six heading records belong to media transcription, not accessibility polish, and duplicate one implemented transcription capability.

completedNonProduct.rationale: All four records are unchecked audit-plan instructions saying to run a focused test and confirm failure; they are not product requirements and should be filtered by requirement extraction.
